name: protected-paths-guard
description: Denies Edit, Write and NotebookEdit calls on sensitive paths (.env files, lockfiles, CI workflows, git internals, private keys) with a glob allowlist override. A tool.call hook with an array matcher.

protect.title: Extra protected globs
protect.description: Comma-separated globs to protect on top of the defaults

allow.title: Always-allowed globs
allow.description: Comma-separated globs that are always allowed (checked first)
